# shmuelie-dotnet

.NET and Windows application engineering skills.

```text
copilot plugin marketplace add shmuelie/shmuelie-skills
copilot plugin install shmuelie-dotnet@shmuelie-skills
```

## Skills

| Skill | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `csharp-interop` | COM, P/Invoke, Native AOT, shell integration, and native hosting |
| `dotnet-project-init` | Modern .NET repository, solution, test, packaging, and CI setup |
| `icon-assets` | Application, MSIX, NuGet, and web icon asset generation |
| `msix-store-submission` | MSIX packaging and Microsoft Store submission |
| `roslyn-sourcegen` | Incremental source generators, analyzers, diagnostics, and testing |
| `winui3-msix` | WinUI 3 binding, packaging, testing, and dependency injection |
